verdict.rationale: Asking whether customer data is excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS analytics service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions AI training policies, an opt-out, or a no-training commitment. The claims that Plausible collects no personal data and can be self-hosted are adjacent privacy features, not a documented control over AI training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
